coordinates.mirrorPolicy: Store anatomical handedness after a source-specific mirror correction; never infer a correction silently.

dominanceNormalization.selection: The detected hand present in the most decoded frames is dominant; ties keep the right hand as dominant.
dominanceNormalization.leftDominantRule: Reflect x coordinates, exchange paired left/right body anchors, and place the detected left hand in the dominant slot.
dominanceNormalization.reason: Do not make left-handed signing a separate class; match the source dataset's published handedness normalization.

shapeNormalization.scale: mean 3D distance from wrist to index MCP, middle MCP, and pinky MCP
shapeNormalization.rotation: none; preserve palm and finger orientation

normalization.fallback: Body-relative features are missing when both shoulders are not reliable; do not substitute an unverified scale.

sequence.raw: Keep increasing source timestamps and all successfully decoded frames before normalization.
sequence.resampling: Nearest decoded source frame by timestamp across the reviewed sign interval; do not interpolate across missing detections.
sequence.missingValues: Use zero coordinates only together with an explicit zero presence or visibility value; never treat zero as observed data.
sequence.frameFeatureLayout: dominant hand 68, non-dominant hand 68, then 13 body anchors x 4 in canonical right-dominant coordinates

requirements.bodyChannels: Required only when catalog metadata says body-relative location is discriminative.
requirements.faceExpressionChannels: Not included in v1; signs requiring non-manual facial distinctions must be excluded or explicitly marked unsupported.
